create_train_config: create a train_config dataclass instance to configure LLaMA model fine-tuning parameters
configure_peft_lora: configure the train_config to use LoRA as the PEFT method for parameter efficient fine-tuning
enable_fsdp_sharding: set enable_fsdp to true in train_config to shard model parameters across DDP ranks
configure_gradient_clipping: set gradient_clipping and gradient_clipping_threshold in train_config to stabilize training
configure_profiling: enable flop_counter or use_profiler in train_config to measure model throughput and performance
